## Description

**What**: Update existing project documentation to accurately reflect the new reviewer-base.md sections, cited_lines mandatory schema, and REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci marker introduced by this epic.

**Why**: Future agents and developers need accurate documentation to understand the review pipeline's evidence requirements and severity calibration. Stale docs that omit the cited_lines field or reference the old "Do NOT add extra fields" prohibition will mislead consumers.

**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md review pipeline section (new rubrics, cited_lines field with format spec, REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci marker); any existing docs referencing reviewer schema or severity levels that become stale; removing or updating any doc that states "findings do not require evidence citations" or references the old security overlay prohibition
- OUT: Creating new documentation files; updating docs for changes belonging to other epics

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md review pipeline section accurately describes: the severity calibration rubric, NOT-flag auto-downgrade rules, cited_lines mandatory field (with `<path>:<line>` / `~<path>:<line>` format spec), and REVIEW_CONTEXT: ci marker behavior
  ← Satisfies: "future agents have accurate awareness of the updated review pipeline"
- When this story is complete, any existing documentation that states findings do not require evidence citations or references the old security overlay "Do NOT add extra fields" prohibition has been updated or removed

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting, structure, and conventions
data.title: Update project docs to reflect review pipeline hardening (severity rubric, NOT-flag rules, cited_lines, CI context marker)
